description: Supplemental attribute recording a component's forced outage status directly, rather than as a probability. `outage_status` is 1 when the component is outaged and 0 when it is available, and it can be backed by a time series drawn from a stochastic simulation or from historical records.
title: FixedForcedOutage

monitored_components.description: IDs of devices whose post-contingency state should be modeled when this outage occurs. Empty by default; semantics of an empty list are decided by the downstream consumer.
